match.name_re: ^(รถไฟฟ้าเอราวัน|AERA)

exemptions.reason: Airport Rail Link (Bangkok) ways carry highspeed=yes in OSM and belong to the 'High-Speed Rail Linking Three Airports' relation, but ARL is a 160 km/h commuter/airport line (UIC 200 km/h floor not met). Real high-speed track in Thailand is only the Bangkok-Nakhon Ratchasima line, still under construction.
